goal_outcome: Deliver a physically verified synthetic collection of 40 imported files without duplicate transfers

deliverable.identity: 40-file verified synthetic import, not downstream production or publication

steps.operation: Verify the 35 present files against the known 40-item synthetic manifest without duplicating them.
steps.verification: unique identity and SHA-256 match, no copied duplicates
steps.failure_route: record exact missing or corrupt entries

steps.operation: Obtain or repair only the five invalid or missing synthetic inputs from authorized project-local sources.
steps.physical_output: up to five recovered files and manifest updates
steps.verification: file exists, expected format and SHA-256 recorded
steps.failure_route: hold only affected input IDs; retain verified files

steps.operation: Emit one source-bound import manifest and an acceptance-ready receipt; do not run provider/model calls.
steps.verification: all 40 present with verified hashes; CLIENT acceptance independently recorded only if actually given
steps.failure_route: report exact missing IDs; preserve unaffected files

forbidden_work: claim publishing rights from local import acceptance
exit_when_blocked: Stop after the bounded missing-input recovery attempts; preserve already verified files and report exact unresolved IDs. Any later public usage or rights gate is independently owned.
